name: Milf Dream
source:
Do you want to hook up the hottest moms? We got you covered, mild lovers! Enjoy the story with a bit of roleplay where you can name all characters!

The story follows a college student who's boring life comes to an end when his friend's mom thanks him for helping her son studying. Where will it all lead to? It's up to you!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2714640/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
想跟最火辣的妈妈们约会吗？熟女爱好者们，你们来对地方了！在这段带点角色扮演趣味的故事里，所有角色都能由你命名。

主人公是个大学生。为了感谢他辅导儿子功课，朋友的妈妈特地来找他，他那百无聊赖的日子就此结束。接下来会怎样？由你决定！
